Swiss Federal Statistical Office (FSO). Federal Population Census 1970. Resident population by type of residence, institutional geographic levels, main language and nationality (category).

Official FSO Federal Population Census counts. Data represent main language and are not explicitly mother-tongue/L1 data. In FSO STAT-TAB, select Year: 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000; Canton / District / Commune: Switzerland; Main language: Select all; Nationality (category): Total.
